_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture, not real data (test/recording-stats.test.ts). As of 2026-08-24, a sample of 34 live zarr indexes -- every MEG/NIRS/motion/EMG dataset reachable plus a broad EEG/iEEG sample -- contained ZERO multi-group stores, so max-within-store and sum-within-store agree on every real index today. This fixture is the only thing that exercises the transposed-rule failure mode: a recording whose file mixes sampling rates (biosigIO names the resulting groups '{modality}_{rate}hz') produces a store with more than one channel group, which are concurrent streams of the SAME recording, not separate recordings. Store duration must be max(group durations), never their sum.
